svg.title: Multimodal masked prediction architecture diagram
svg.desc: Editable reconstruction of the original figure. The main base frames are the top fusion module, right predictor module, lower target encoder module, the left input/legend area, and the bottom loss area. Contents are arranged left-to-right from input image, skeleton and language caption into token streams, projection blocks, fusion/target encoders, predictor outputs and MSE losses. Symmetry basis: top and lower dashed modules share aligned projection columns; prediction and target/loss sections use three modality rows.
